builds.goal: Reference for Draven: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A high-pressure ranged attacker who sustains empowered axes and converts champion kills into accumulated gold. testPlan: Kit question for Draven: Fix axe count and catches, then compare damage without dropping axes while repositioning. Gold from kills is earned, not a free six-item assumption.

Start with the early core (Collector, then Infinity Edge) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

kitEvidence.formula:
Draven readies a Spinning Axe, causing his next Attack to deal an additional [40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60 + (0.75 / 0.85 / 0.95 / 1.05 / 1.15) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and ricochet into the air. If Draven catches it, he readies another Spinning Axe.

Draven can hold two Spinning Axes at once.

Draven becomes Ghosted, gains [50 / 55 / 60 / 65 / 70]% Move Speed decaying over [1.5] seconds and [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40]% Attack Speed for [3] seconds.

When Draven catches a Spinning Axe, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.
Draven chucks a sideways axe that deals [75 / 110 / 145 / 180 / 215 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, Knocks Back, and Slows by [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40]% for [2] seconds.

Draven gains [1] stack whenever he kills a non-champion unit or turret, catches a Spinning Axe.

Draven gains [25] gold plus [2] additional gold per stack upon killing a champion. Draven loses [50]% of stacks upon death.

Total Gold Earned: [(1) × BuffStacks(DravenPassiveGoldEarned)]
Highest Reward: [(1) × BuffStacks(DravenPassiveHighestBounty)]

Draven hurls two massive axes that deal [200 / 300 / 400 + (1.1 / 1.3 / 1.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. Upon hitting a champion or Recasting, they reverse direction and return to Draven. The axes deal [5]% less damage for each enemy hit, down to a minimum of [50]%.

If {{ Spell_DravenRCast_Name }} would leave an enemy champion with less health than [100]% of Draven's current {{Spell_DravenPassive_Name}} stacks ([(1) × BuffStacks({577427b5})]), he will execute them.

builds.name: Axe-catch spellblade rhythm
builds.summary: Make each catch a controlled ability-and-attack sequence.
builds.goal: Make each catch a controlled ability-and-attack sequence.
builds.hypothesis: Spinning Axe adds up to 1.15 AD statFormula=2 physical damage to its attack; catching refreshes Blood Rush. Essence Reaver adds physical Spellblade and mana to a post-W attack, while Stormrazor's energized speed helps reach the next landing circle. Crit supports ordinary attack damage but axe bonus treatment must be measured separately.
testPlan: Required state: Need two maintained axes, sensible W pacing and room to catch safely.
Compare mana and total trade damage with W only when Spellblade is ready versus spammed catches.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Rapid W refreshes can outpace Spellblade readiness and catching into CC loses both axes.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Catch refresh does not refresh Essence Reaver's internal item cooldown.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Essence Reaver, Bloodthirster, Stormrazor, Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Whirling execution specialist
builds.summary: Prioritize two-pass ultimate damage and earned Adoration thresholds.
builds.goal: Prioritize two-pass ultimate damage and earned Adoration thresholds.
builds.hypothesis: Whirling Death has a rank-varying 1.1-1.5 AD expression, reverses after champion contact or recast and loses damage through earlier units. Muramana supplies AD/mana subject to spell proc limits; Axiom refunds R only after qualifying deaths, and lethality serves physical damage. Passive Adoration provides a bounded execute threshold, not combat stats or guaranteed income.
testPlan: Required state: Need charged Manamune, earned surviving Adoration and an unobstructed return line.
Measure both R passes at fixed stack counts and compare early reversal versus maximum travel.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Dying halves stacks; unit attenuation or target movement can erase the execute setup.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Adoration stacks are not unlimited and catching axes does not directly lower R cooldown.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
